gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-hepta-slab: Aaargh leads with a wide-mouthed e and bowls that match its stems, strong and commanding. Hepta Slab follows with a bookish, stretched-out look and no thick-thin shifts, which is the pair's real strength: dignity next to muscle.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Padyakke Expanded One reads slowly and grandly, its glyphs strung out like knots on a slack rope. Aaargh sits above it with a commanding, even-handed build, and a bigger size for the heading than the body would be a sensible suggestion.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-stint-ultra-expande: The standout trait of Aaargh is how generously it opens the eye of the e, with bowls and stems all drawn at one weight. It earns its keep big and short; Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-domine: Alien Encounters spaces its letter pairs with big, open gaps, giving the heading an otherworldly, technological feel. Domine answers with a classic serif's refined dignity, and its body text is best given a comfortable size so those tall lowercase forms can breathe.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-esteban: Alien Encounters is all gaps and height, otherworldly and technological. Its tall x-height shines on big display lines, while Esteban, a refined serif with a wide-open e and subtle etched contrast, is happiest in running text.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-faustina: Otherworldly spacing up top, with tall letters set apart by generous gaps in Alien Encounters. And Faustina, a serif with open-jawed c shapes and thin-but-gentle bowls, carries a longer stretch of text with a classic, authoritative steadiness.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-halant: Halant brings a towering x-height and outward-pointing terminals, authoritative and traditional in its feel, with a faint thick-thin shift. It makes a longer read comfortable beside Alien Encounters.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-headland-: Headland One is a dignified serif with letters set well apart, a tall rounded o and gently varying strokes, much like the spacing of Alien Encounters. That shared love of space is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-hedvig-le: Spaced-out and futuristic, Alien Encounters stretches its tall letters apart with big gaps, then Hedvig Letters Serif adds sturdy, open-ended lowercase with light stroke modulation. They sit together comfortably, one strange and one steady.
